property_risoul.name: Risoul 1850 Apartment
property_risoul.description: 26 m² apartment with balcony and ski locker, steps from the slopes in the Altaïr residence (3rd floor, lift, no overlooking neighbours). Sleeps 4–6. Sleeping area with 2 bunk beds (80x180cm), separated from the living room by a door. Bathroom with bathtub, separate WC. Bright east-facing living room with 2 pull-out beds and sliding partition for a private bedroom. Equipped kitchenette: fridge, dishwasher, 4-ring ceramic hob, microwave/grill, coffee makers, raclette/crêpe set, toaster, kettle. Flat-screen TV, board games. Balcony with table and chairs. Shops and medical practice nearby. ⚠️ Bed linen not provided — guests must clean before departure. School ski holidays (Feb/March): weekly rentals only (Saturday to Saturday).

property_avignon.name: Avignon Intramuros Apartment
property_avignon.description: Recently renovated 20 m² studio nestled in a quiet lane inside the ramparts of Avignon, close to all shops and tourist attractions. Sleeping area with a sofa bed comprising 2 single beds. Large wardrobe with hanging space and shelves. Fan for summer nights. Car access possible — city car parks recommended. Available July and August only. Minimum 2 nights.

property_lauris1.name: Maison de Mémé
property_lauris1.description: Characterful house in the heart of the village of Lauris, near shops and the château. Ground floor: large living room with equipped kitchen, WC. 1st floor: sitting room with TV, WC, large dressing room, shower room, bedroom (2 single beds), bedroom (double bed + dressing). 2nd floor: 2 bedrooms with double beds, shower room with WC, outdoor terrace under the eaves. Fully equipped kitchen: toaster, kettle, Nespresso, filter coffee maker, microwave, oven, fridge/freezer, washing machine, induction hob, dishwasher. Free WiFi. Car recommended. Ideal weekly (Sat–Sat), minimum 2 nights. Can be combined with the adjoining house for larger groups.

property_lauris2.name: L'Atelier
property_lauris2.description: Fully renovated house in the heart of the village of Lauris, 5 km from Lourmarin. Ground floor: living room with equipped kitchen, WC. 1st floor: storage room (washing machine, WC), master suite (shower room, double bed, dressing room). 2nd floor: master suite (double bed) + outdoor terrace. Fully equipped kitchen: toaster, kettle, Nespresso, filter coffee maker, microwave, oven, fridge/freezer, washing machine, induction hob, dishwasher. Free WiFi. Car recommended, parking 20 m away. ⚠️ Steep stairs. Ideal weekly, minimum 2 nights.

property_lauris3.name: Maison d'Alain
property_lauris3.description: Enjoy authentic Provence in this recently restored family home in the historic heart of a typical Luberon village. Savour the peace of its shaded, car-free square. Tastefully furnished over 2 floors with beautiful spaces for relaxation. Lovely evenings on the large 1st-floor terrace. On the ground floor, the vaulted dining room sets the scene for memorable shared meals. Well-equipped kitchen. 🔹 Minimum 2 nights — Cleaning optional on request — No parties.

lauris.discover_text: Perched on a rocky spur overlooking the Durance valley, Lauris is an authentic Provençal village of cobbled lanes and stone houses. Its 18th-century château is home to a conservatory of dye plants unique in Europe, cascading in terraces down the cliff. On the doorstep of the Luberon Regional Nature Park, 5 km from Lourmarin, it is the perfect base for hiking, local markets and discovering the real Provence.

about.title: Who are we?
about.text: We are the Rougon family, owners of 5 carefully maintained properties in Provence and the Alps. Passionate about travel and hospitality, we open our family homes to offer you authentic stays, far from standardised holiday packages. By booking directly, you deal with us personally — for a warm welcome and conditions tailored to your needs.
